items.source: Finds fitting Neo4jPersistentPropertyConverter for a given property.
items.translation: 查找给定属性的合适Neo4jPersistentPropertyConverter。

items.source: In same cases a factory might be interested in having access to a BeanFactory. In case SDN can provide it, it will prefer such a constructor to the default one or the one taken a Neo4jConversionService.
items.translation: 在某些情况下，工厂可能对访问 BeanFactory 感兴趣。如果 SDN 能够提供该功能，它将优先选择此类构造函数，而不是默认构造函数或采用 Neo4jConversionService 的构造函数。

items.source: Classes implementing this interface should have a default constructor. In case they provide a constructor asking for an instance of Neo4jConversionService, such service is provided. This allows for conversions delegating part of the conversion.
items.translation: 实现此接口的类应提供默认构造函数。如果该类提供了需要 Neo4jConversionService 实例的构造函数，则会自动提供该服务。这使得可以委托部分转换工作。

items.source: persistentProperty - the property for which the converter should be built
items.translation: <persistentProperty> - 需要为其构建转换器的属性

items.source: This interface needs to be implemented to provide custom configuration for a Neo4jPersistentPropertyConverter. Use cases may be specific date formats or the like. The build method will receive the whole property. It is safe to assume that at least the @ConvertWith annotation is present on the property, either directly or meta-annotated.
items.translation: 需要实现此接口以针对Neo4jPersistentPropertyConverter提供自定义配置。用例可能涉及特定的日期格式等场景。构建方法将接收整个属性。可以安全地假设该属性上至少存在@ConvertWith注解，无论是直接添加还是通过元注解添加。
